lines.t: Fans waited five years for this game.
Marvel's Wolverine is a single player action game from the makers of Spider-Man, only on PlayStation 5.
One analyst estimates it sold almost two million copies in three days.
The first teaser hid a license plate, H L K 181. That's the comic where Wolverine first appeared, in 1974.
lines.say: The first teaser hid a license plate: H, L, K, one eighty-one. That's the comic where Wolverine first appeared, in 1974.

lines.t: And yes, this is a real wolverine. Famous for standing up to animals many times its size.
